timing_qualification.measurement_boundary: Frozen controller_call_time_s ends before allocator, Plant and MAT save.
timing_qualification.method_pause_and_failure_note: The original v3 DSSM startup and the v4 preparation both failed before Plant (OS1, 0 calls) and remain separate history. The isolated v4 path diagnostic then exited OS0 with zero Plant calls and is not a method block. The preserved v5 pre-Plant DEV2 failure, v6 one-VAL-Plant DEV2 failure, and v7/v8 zero-Plant prepare failures are disclosed separately. The original DSSM process exit remains UNKNOWN; scenes 1-31 are parent-audited committed files, scene32 retains its no-runIdentity incident exception, and tail16 has a separate natural OS0 receipt. KAN and the three C5 blocks reused the frozen v9 scientific entry under new Recovery208 process receipts; known process gaps and timestamps are retained above.
timing_qualification.thread_argument_interpretation: -singleCompThread sets MATLAB numerical-computation thread behavior; runtime worker threads may remain.
timing_qualification.sysnoise: Sequential method processes; no OS-level timing isolation; initial calls/JIT effects included.

serialization_scope.MATLAB_char_identity: Actual scene/method/candidate/collector strings are checked through frozen char-field decoding.
serialization_scope.MATLAB_cells: Frozen cell-safe decoder and record normalization remain unchanged.
serialization_scope.scene_sceneMeta_spec_semantic_equality: Pinned native MATLAB no-Plant evidence uses isequaln and char(scene_id) against the frozen shared scene pack for all 288 exact run_start files; each row binds method/index/path/SHA and before/after SHA. cfg, opts, model, binding, physical, score and event checks remain under the frozen Python reviewers.
serialization_scope.frozen_input_metadata: The original cfgpack and its metadata remain byte-frozen; corrected historical run_start references are a distinct manifest lineage, not replacement cfgpack bytes.
